exoticPerks.name: Roving Assassin
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Vanish after Spectral Blades kills for more Super energy.
exoticPerks.description:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.

descriptions.flavorText: Smother the lights and run.

exoticPerks.name: Winged Eclipse
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.
exoticPerks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.

descriptions.flavorText: Nobody calls it that.

exoticPerks.name: Horns of Doom
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Defeating targets with Void damage grants a bonus to Void weapons, and defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy. Improves Sentinel Shield.
exoticPerks.description:
Defeating targets with Void damage has a chance to grant an escalating bonus to damage with Void weapons. Defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy.

While Sentinel Shield is active, defeating targets with melee attacks recharges Shield Throw, which extends your Super on hitting a target.

descriptions.flavorText: Take the hits. Give the hits.

exoticPerks.name: Blastwave Striders
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Blast your boots to spray your targets with shrapnel.
exoticPerks.description: Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.

descriptions.flavorText: The ideocosm contained within this helm transforms the wearer's head from flesh and/or exoneurons to the pure, raw stuff of thought.

exoticPerks.name: Move to Survive
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Grants airborne movement and improves Blink.
exoticPerks.description:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

descriptions.flavorText: New growth rises from the old.

exoticPerks.name: One with the Void
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improves duration, damage, and durability of Void Souls.
exoticPerks.description: Your Void Souls have a longer duration. They also gain escalating damage and durability as they defeat targets. You can retrieve your Void Souls by interacting with them, allowing them to be redeployed.

descriptions.flavorText: "The Traveler called me back. Told me my work on this side isn't done yet." —Seong-Do Whiteclaw

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

descriptions.flavorText: New growth rises from the old.

exoticPerks.name: One with the Void
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improves duration, damage, and durability of Void Souls.
exoticPerks.description: Your Void Souls have a longer duration. They also gain escalating damage and durability as they defeat targets. You can retrieve your Void Souls by interacting with them, allowing them to be redeployed.

descriptions.flavorText: "The Traveler called me back. Told me my work on this side isn't done yet." —Seong-Do Whiteclaw

exoticPerks.name: Roving Assassin
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Vanish after Spectral Blades kills for more Super energy.
exoticPerks.description:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.

descriptions.flavorText: Smother the lights and run.

exoticPerks.name: Winged Eclipse
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.
exoticPerks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.

descriptions.flavorText: Nobody calls it that.

exoticPerks.name: Horns of Doom
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Defeating targets with Void damage grants a bonus to Void weapons, and defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy. Improves Sentinel Shield.
exoticPerks.description:
Defeating targets with Void damage has a chance to grant an escalating bonus to damage with Void weapons. Defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy.

While Sentinel Shield is active, defeating targets with melee attacks recharges Shield Throw, which extends your Super on hitting a target.

descriptions.flavorText: Take the hits. Give the hits.

exoticPerks.name: Blastwave Striders
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Blast your boots to spray your targets with shrapnel.
exoticPerks.description: Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.

descriptions.flavorText: The ideocosm contained within this helm transforms the wearer's head from flesh and/or exoneurons to the pure, raw stuff of thought.
